application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T1 - Positioned on top of the raised retaining wall of the underground carpark, and the boundary fence line in a gap of no more than 20cm. The tree has been pollarded several times historically, but the trunk, as the tree ages, is getting wider. If left in situ as is, this tree will cause damage to the retaining brick wall and/or fence. The tree also has branches touching the balconies and windows of the apartment block. RSL therefore recommends that it be removed to a low stump and then treated to prevent regrowth.

G1 - Positioned on top of the raised retaining wall of the underground carpark, and the boundary fence line in a gap of no more than 20cm. These trees have been pollarded several times historically, but the trunks, as the trees age, are getting wider. If left in situ as is, these trees will cause damage to the retaining brick wall and/or fence. They also have branches touching the balconies and windows of the apartment block. RSL therefore recommends that they be removed to low stumps and then treated to prevent regrowth.
